subject: Re: Production latency incident — compensation proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Severe latency during scheduled analytics window — request for remediation + credits

Hi Rishi,

We had a significant incident this morning (2026-01-13) when our nightly analytics job started generating 10x latency on model inference and repeatedly timed out between 02:10–06:45 PST. This impacted our downstream reporting and triggered customer alerts — we estimate ~3.5 hours of degraded service and retried jobs that incurred extra cost.

We raised an incident through the console at 02:22 and worked with the on-call, but recovery was slow. Can you share the postmortem and let us know what compensation Redwood is prepared to provide? This was a customer-facing outage window for Acme HealthTech and we need an internal summary for our Ops review.

We'd like:
- A brief incident summary and root cause
- Quantified impact (tokens/requests affected, any failed requests)
- Proposed compensation (credits or invoice adjustment) and timeline to receive them

Thanks — this is urgent for our Feb compliance review.

— Susan
Susan Lewis
Director, Platform Engineering 
Acme HealthTech
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency during scheduled analytics window — request for remediation + credits

Hi Susan — thanks for flagging and I’m really sorry you had to deal with this. I wanted to acknowledge receipt and share next steps so you have a point of contact.

What we’re doing now:
- I’ve opened an internal postmortem and attached a preliminary incident timeline (will follow with the formal postmortem by EOD Wed).
- I’m looping in Marissa (CS) and Stephanie (Sales Ops) to coordinate a compensation proposal and any invoice adjustments.
- We’ll quantify tokens/requests affected and propose a credit amount by Jan 15th.

Interim ask for you: if you can send the rough count of impacted jobs or attach any job IDs, that will help speed the calculation. Otherwise we’ll correlate with your usage metrics on our end.

I’ll be back with a concrete proposal within 48 hours. Again — truly sorry for the disruption.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Acme latency incident — recommend $8k goodwill credit + 60-day trial extension

Team — forwarding Susan's note and our preliminary timeline. Key facts from incident logs: 02:10–06:45 PST sustained latency spike, approx. 1.2M additional token usage from retries, and ~450 failed requests that timed out. Acme is an enterprise account on Dedicated capacity (monthly commit).

My recommendation: offer a one-time goodwill credit of $8,000 (applied to next invoice) + 60-day free extension of their current trial seats for the pilot teams. Rationale: balances measured impact, preserves relationship, and is within our goodwill guidelines for accounts of this size.

Attachments: redwood_incident_postmortem_20260113.pdf (draft), acme_usage_report_202601.csv (usage extract).

Can we get approvals from Sales Ops and Legal to proceed? If Finance needs a different token-denominated credit, we can convert $8k to a token credit value.

Thanks — Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme latency incident — recommend $8k goodwill credit + 60-day trial extension

Rishi — thanks for the summary and the attachments. I reviewed the usage extract and the customer footprint — $8k looks reasonable. Approve from CS side. Please do the following before sending to the customer:

- Confirm credit mechanics with Finance (one-time invoice credit vs promo code)
- If applying to next invoice, ensure we add a short one-line credit memo referencing incident ticket #INC-20260113-R
- Draft the outbound note that includes remediation summary + credit details (I can review)

Stephanie — can you confirm Finance Ops is OK with $8,000 as a one-time invoice adjustment? Markus — if Legal wants any language in the customer note or a short signed acceptance for the credit, shout now.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme latency incident — recommend $8k goodwill credit + 60-day trial extension

All — legal is OK to proceed with a one-time $8,000 credit and 60-day trial extension. Two notes:

1) Please document the credit with a short credit memo and internal ticket (Finance needs the memo for audit).
2) For clarity, the credit is goodwill and does not modify the SLA or create an ongoing obligation — include a sentence to that effect in the outbound email.

Recommended internal tracking: promo code: PROMO-ACME-202601-8K and credit memo reference CR-MEMO-20260118-ACME. I’ve added a link to the internal credit request form here: https://finance.redwood.com/credits/submit/ACME-20260118

Once Finance confirms posting mechanics, Rishi please send the note to Susan and cc Marissa.

— Markus
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency during scheduled analytics window — compensation and next steps

Hi Susan — thanks again for your patience. We’ve completed the internal review and here’s what Redwood will do to remediate the impact from Jan 13: 

Summary / root cause (short):
- Root cause: stalled batch eviction logic + contention on KV cache during a high-concurrency analytics window; engineers deployed a fix and tuned cache eviction at 04:05 PST, full stabilization by 06:45 PST. Full postmortem is attached.

Compensation offer:
- One-time goodwill credit of $8,000 applied to your next invoice (promo code PROMO-ACME-202601-8K or Finance can apply it as a credit memo CR-MEMO-20260118-ACME).
- 60-day extension of the trial seats for your pilot teams (no action required from you; we’ll apply on our side).

Next steps:
- I’ve attached the incident postmortem and your usage extract. Finance will apply the credit by Jan 22; I’ll confirm once posted.
- If you’d like a short acknowledgement of the credit on Redwood letterhead for your audit, I can arrange that.

We value the partnership with Acme and want to make sure this disruption is made right. Please let me know if this resolution works for you and whether you’d like the audit acknowledgement.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
